system.description: You spend 5 minutes haggling over the price of items or negotiating to get what you want through compromise. If you haggle with other entities (not merchants), you do so with Disadvantage. Make an INT-Opposed Skill Check. On Success, you increase or decrease the price 10% in your favor. If you're not haggling, the opponent tentatively agrees to your terms.

upgrades.description: Your party members can also buy or sell at your newly-negotiated price.
Increase or decrease the price by an additional 10% in your favor.
Increase or decrease the price by an additional 15% in your favor.

system.limitations: Does not work on members of your own party. Some items have a minimum price.
